name: DJ Vic
blurb: A cinematic booking site for an international DJ. Visitors are routed by event type (weddings, corporate, club), with remixes and The Vic Fix alongside and a 24-hour reply promise.

name: Lloyd’s Pro Sound & Lighting
blurb: Sound, light and music, run by one team. Since 2008, 1,000+ events and a 4.7★ Google rating are up front, with event-type pages and direct WhatsApp booking.

name: DJ Gags
blurb: “The Room Never Lies.” A photography-led site for a DJ, producer and remixer. 26 years and six residencies serve as proof, with availability checks and WhatsApp booking above the fold.

name: SNLA · Sapna Naik Landscape Architecture
blurb: A full-bleed, image-first portfolio where the projects do the talking. Minimal navigation keeps attention on the work, with project pages, careers and contact one click away.

name: Supriya Bopanna
blurb: A quiet, editorial site for a psychologist: a custom “perspective” wordmark, serif type and generous whitespace. It explains plainly how sessions work and who the practice is for.
